Welcome
HEADTEACHER’S WELCOME
A very warm welcome to the Pepper Hill School website.
At Pepper Hill we are a fully inclusive, diverse, school which ensures that children become lifelong learners through an exciting and enriching curriculum.
Our website will have all the information you, and your child, will need while at Pepper Hill and we encourage you to check regularly for school updates and events. Our core values of building the foundations for success are at the heart of all we do.
We hope our website gives you a taste of life at Pepper Hill and how proud we are of our school. If you are interested to find out more and would like a tour to see our wonderful facilities, children and staff in action, please contact the school office to make an appointment.
Miss Helen Nicholson

Funded Childcare
Funded Childcare for 3 and 4 year-olds
From the term after their third birthday, until they start school, your child is entitled to 15 funded hours of early learning per week, for 38 weeks a year during school term time. At Pepper Hill School this is divided into daily 3 hour sessions, where your child will attend from Monday to Friday each week.
15 hours Funded Childcare
Pepper Hill School Nursery offer two 15 hour funded sessions:
Morning Session: 8.30am-11.30am
Afternoon Session: 12.15pm-3.15pm
What should I do?
Check the table below to see when your child is eligible:
1 April and 31 August
Start of Autumn funding period (from 1st September)
1 September and 31 December
Start of Spring funding period (from 1st January)
1 January and 31 March
Start of Summer funding period (from 1st April)
Please note, we are only able to accept children into our Nursery as per the table above.
30 hours Funded Childcare
Some children of working parents may be eligible for an extra 15 hours of funded early education.
Find out more about 30 hours entitlement: https://www.gov.uk/30-hours-free-childcare
Pepper Hill School Nursery offers a 30 hour session, divided into 6 hours per day, from 8.30am – 2.30pm, with lunch provided. Parents are able to pay to increase these hours by 45 minutes to take advantage of the full afternoon session, if they so wish, finishing at 3.15pm.
Tax-Free Childcare
The government introduced a Tax-Free Childcare scheme which can be used alongside the 15 and 30 hours of funded childcare. You can apply for both the 30 hours and Tax-Free Childcare schemes through one online application.
Find out more about the Tax-Free Childcare scheme here: https://www.gov.uk/tax-free-childcare

pageCache.pageTitle: Pepper Hill School - Music Development Plan
pageCache.text:
Music Development Plan
At Pepper Hill School we aim for all our pupils to develop a life-long love of music, in a school with a musical atmosphere through a wide range of quality musical experiences which engage and inspire them. At the heart of the music curriculum are creativity, curiosity and excitement and children who are developing increased self-confidence, self-esteem and collaborative skills. We aim to build a curriculum with musical sound at the cornerstone with a progressive pathway for every child. Music opportunities will support children’s mental health and allow them time to express their emotions.
Children will perform, listen and analyse critically, sing, improvise and compose music and understand the musical elements as building blocks within music.

pageCache.pageTitle: Pepper Hill School - School Sports Premium
pageCache.text:
School Sports Premium
SPORTS PREMIUM FUNDING
Pepper Hill School has been in receipt of additional government funding specified as 'Sport Premium' since its introduction in September 2013. We aim to utilise this extra funding to improve all aspects of Physical Activity. This includes maximising pupil progress, increasing participation in sport, professional development of staff and helping all our pupils to develop healthy lifestyles and positive attitudes towards Physical Education.
At Pepper Hill School, we recognise the contribution of PE to the health and well-being of the children. We believe that an innovative, varied PE curriculum and extra-curricular opportunities have a positive influence on the concentration, attitude and academic achievement of all our children.
Below are the Primary School PE and Sport Premium documents.
School Sports Premium

Breakfast Club
We have a Breakfast club which runs daily, Monday to Friday, from 7:45am at a cost of £2.50 each day.
As well as breakfast, the club provides a quiet place for the children to read and listen to stories, or other activities including board games, table football, listening to music and sports activities.
Places can be booked in advance via ParentMail.
